title: Inquiry - Soda Ash Dense - PT Glassworks Nusantara - CFR Semarang

header.subject: Inquiry - Soda Ash Dense - PT Glassworks Nusantara - CFR Semarang

text:
Dear Export Sales Team,

Thank you for the catalogue. We are PT Glassworks Nusantara, a glass container
manufacturer based in Semarang with one float furnace and two container lines.

Please quote the following:

Product     : Soda ash dense, granular
Quality     : Na2CO3 99.2% min; Fe 0.003% max; particle size +80 mesh 75% min
Quantity    : 300 MT for the first shipment, approximately 3,000 MT per year
Delivery    : CFR Semarang, Indonesia
Packing     : Please advise your standard export packing for this product.
Documents   : COA, SDS and TDS with the offer.

For the sample we will arrange collection with our own forwarder.

Payment: L/C.

Kindly note the price should be competitive as we are comparing with our
current supplier.

We look forward to your offer.

Best regards,

Budi Santoso
Procurement Department
PT Glassworks Nusantara
Kawasan Industri Terboyo Blok C-12
Semarang 50111, Central Java, Indonesia
Tel: +62 24 766 1234 | HP: 0812 2599 8888
